items.author: amiibru.bsky.social
items.context: [GameChallenge] Can you recommend retro games? Maybe I can start 5 out of these: Zelda 2 Donkey Kong Country Earthbound Beginnings Chrono Trigger Final Fantasy Adventure MegaMan Castlevania Kid Icarus Kirby's Dream Land 3 Sonic The Hedgehog Earthworm Jim Bubsy Gex Tomba Rayman Toy Story Ninja Gaiden
items.text: Fun list. Chrono Trigger is a great place to start, and Donkey Kong Country is easy to pick up for a quick session.
